Description: As a returning customer, I want to copy my referral link from my account page in one step so that I can share it without asking support
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: Referral link is copied for sharing
Given a returning customer is signed in
When the customer chooses to copy their referral link
Then the link is available to paste
And the link identifies the customer as the referrer

Scenario: Each customer has a different link
Given two returning customers are signed in
When each opens their referral link
Then the two links are different

Title 2: Generate a unique referral code per customer
Description: Delivers the scenario where every customer gets a unique link.

Title 2: Show the referral link with a copy button on the account page
Description: Delivers the scenario where the customer copies the link.

Title 2: Test the account page for a customer without a code
Description: Covers the error scenario where the code is missing.

Title 1: Receive credit for a friend's first order
Description: As a returning customer, I want to receive store credit when my friend completes a first order so that I am rewarded for recommending the store
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: Referrer is credited after the first paid order
Given a friend arrived through a customer's referral link
And the friend placed and paid a first order
When the order is marked as completed
Then the referrer receives the referral credit
And the referrer is notified of the credit

Scenario: Credit is not given for an unpaid order
Given a friend arrived through a referral link
And the friend's order payment failed
When the order is cancelled
Then the referrer receives no credit

Scenario: Credit is given only once per friend
Given a referrer was already credited for a friend
When the friend completes a second order
Then the referrer receives no additional credit

Title 2: Credit the referrer after the friend's first completed order
Description: Delivers the scenario where the reward is granted only after completion.

Title 2: Ignore reward triggers from orders that are not the friend's first
Description: Covers the alternative scenario of a repeated order.

Title 2: Test crediting when the order is cancelled before completion
Description: Covers the error scenario of a cancelled order.

Title 1: See the friend discount from the referral link
Description: As a referred friend, I want to see my discount when I arrive through a referral link and again at checkout so that I know the offer is real before I buy
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: Discount is shown on arrival
Given a visitor opens a valid referral link
When the store page loads
Then the visitor sees the friend discount offer
And the visitor sees who invited them

Scenario: Discount is applied at checkout
Given a visitor arrived through a valid referral link and added items to the cart
When the visitor reaches checkout
Then the discount appears as a line in the order summary

Scenario: Invalid link shows no discount
Given a visitor opens a referral link that does not exist
When the store page loads
Then no discount is shown
And the visitor can still browse and buy at regular prices

Title 2: Read the referral code from the arrival link and keep it in the session
Description: Delivers the scenario where the friend arrives through the link.

Title 2: Show the discount on the landing page and again at checkout
Description: Delivers the scenario where the friend sees the offer before buying.

Title 2: Test an invalid or expired referral code
Description: Covers the error scenario of a bad link.

Title 1: Check the status of my invitations
Description: As a returning customer, I want to see whether each invited friend has registered or ordered so that I know when to expect my credit
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: Referrer sees each stage
Given a customer has invited three friends, one registered and one ordered
When the customer opens the referral page
Then the customer sees counts for invited, registered and ordered

Scenario: Empty state explains how to start
Given a customer has not shared the link yet
When the customer opens the referral page
Then the customer sees how the program works and the link to copy

Title 2: List the invitations of the referrer with their status
Description: Delivers the scenario where the referrer checks each invitation.

Title 2: Show an empty state when there are no invitations
Description: Covers the alternative scenario of a new referrer.
As a program owner, I want the system to refuse rewards when the referrer and the friend are the same person so that reward cost is not wasted on fake referrals
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: Same customer cannot reward themselves
Given a customer opens their own referral link in a new account with the same payment method
When the new account completes a first order
Then no discount is given to the new account
And no credit is given to the referrer

Scenario: Legitimate referral is unaffected
Given a friend with a different account and payment method arrives through a referral link
When the friend completes a first order
Then both the discount and the credit are granted

Title 2: Reject a referral code that belongs to the buyer
Description: Delivers the scenario where self-referral is blocked.

Title 2: Allow only one reward per referred friend
Description: Delivers the scenario where repeated rewards are blocked.

Title 2: Test self-referral with a different email on the same account
Description: Covers the error scenario of a disguised self-referral.
